name: Procurement_Settings
label: Procurement Settings
_about: Control Panel, Procurement group (spec 05 Shared Engines / 08, CP-R1..R6). The catalogue of settings (label, default, min, max, what it affects) lives in server/modules/procurement/settings-defs.mjs; a row here only stores a changed value. No row = the default. Every change is written to Procurement_Settings_History.
